task: Binary visible loose/raised-rock appearance, including small rocks; do not infer metric hazard size from RGB. Existing four-class navigation output is frozen.
annotation: Full visible object polygons where clear, explicit ground/hardware/sky negatives, unreviewed and boundary-uncertain regions255. Small visible rocks separate from substantial visual candidates; no invented depth.
architecture: Frozen v11 navigation encoder and head; train a separate binary appearance decoder. This avoids drift of the production navigation weights while learning new rock examples.

training_plan.class_weighting: balanced positive/negative within each batch, capped; no fixed16x rare class pressure
training_plan.selection: Binary masked validation IoU on five old validation episodes plus three new predeclared validation episodes (dunes800, gravel1400, flat bedrock1700), all source roles fixed before predictions.

filter_policy_fixed_before_test.new_probability: Move suppressed obstacle mass to ground. No other navigation probability is increased; hardware/sky probabilities unchanged.

fresh_test_gates.ground_false_positive_fraction: No increase; require relative decrease≥5% if baseline has≥1000 ground-FP pixels, otherwise explicitly report insufficient discrimination.

inference_policy: whole512, no threshold tuning on fresh test
promotion: Require all gates and manual review. Otherwise keep v11 and retain research artifacts. New test becomes consumed after its first opening.
